reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Removed support for the `1.20` `compatibilityProfile`. This configured the following settings: `ENABLE_EXTERNAL_NAME_ALIAS`, `PERSIST_OLDEST_FIRST_HEURISTIC_FO…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Any configuration using the 1.20 compatibilityProfile or its associated removed feature flags (ENABLE_EXTERNAL_NAME_ALIAS, PERSIST_OLDEST_FIRST_HEURISTIC_FOR_VIRTUAL_SERVICE_HOST_MATCHING, VERIFY_CERTIFICATE_AT_CLIENT) will be ignored or cause failures after upgrade.
consequence.remediation: Remove any references to the 1.20 compatibilityProfile and update configurations using the removed feature flags. ENABLE_AUTO_SNI remains available as an alternative.

proposed.statement: Support for the 1.20 compatibilityProfile has been removed, along with the feature flags it configured (ENABLE_EXTERNAL_NAME_ALIAS, PERSIST_OLDEST_FIRST_HEURISTIC_FOR_VIRTUAL_SERVICE_HOST_MATCHING, VERIFY_CERTIFICATE_AT_CLIENT), while ENABLE_AUTO_SNI remains available.
